profile.name: Dhimas Nurhidayat
profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.bio: Saya membangun aplikasi web, sistem backend, dan produk digital yang praktis - cepat, mudah digunakan, dan tampil rapi di berbagai perangkat.
profile.longBio: Saya mahasiswa Informatika di Universitas Pembangunan Jaya dengan fokus pada full-stack development. Latar belakang Multimedia dari SMK memberi fondasi desain, lalu saya mendalaminya ke pengembangan web modern - dari tampilan hingga sistem di balik layar.
profile.bio_en: I build web applications, backend systems, and practical digital products - fast, easy to use, and clean across devices.
profile.longBio_en: I am an Informatics student at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya focused on full-stack development. A Multimedia background from vocational school gave me a design foundation, which I then deepened into modern web development - from the interface down to the systems behind it.

projects.title: Tasku
projects.shortDescription: Mobile-first task manager for daily to-dos and schedules.
projects.description: Tasku adalah task manager mobile-first untuk mengelola to-do dan jadwal harian. Fokus pada produktivitas dengan UI bersih, filter cepat, dan pengingat tugas.
projects.problem: Jadwal harian yang berantakan membutuhkan alat pencatat yang cepat dan mudah diakses dari ponsel.
projects.solution: Aplikasi task manager mobile-first dengan filter cepat dan pengingat, dibangun dengan React dan Tailwind.
features: Kelola to-do dan jadwal harian secara mobile-first.
UI bersih dengan fokus pada produktivitas.
projects.shortDescription_en: Mobile-first task manager for daily to-dos and schedules.
projects.description_en: Tasku is a mobile-first task manager for to-dos and daily schedules. It focuses on productivity with a clean UI, quick filters, and task reminders.
projects.problem_en: A messy daily schedule needs a fast capture tool that is easy to reach from a phone.
projects.solution_en: A mobile-first task manager with quick filters and reminders, built with React and Tailwind.
features_en: Manage to-dos and daily schedules mobile-first.
A clean UI focused on productivity.

projects.title: Pohon Untuk Esok
projects.shortDescription: Community tree-donation tracker with progress cards.
projects.description: Platform donasi pohon berbasis komunitas dengan tracking progres, visual chart, dan halaman kampanye yang mudah dibagikan.
projects.problem: Gerakan donasi lingkungan butuh halaman kampanye yang transparan dan mudah dibagikan.
projects.solution: Tracker donasi dengan chart progres dan kartu milestone yang shareable, dibangun dengan Next.js.
features: Tracking donasi pohon dengan visual chart.
UI ramah komunitas untuk gerakan lingkungan.
projects.shortDescription_en: Community tree-donation tracker with progress cards.
projects.description_en: A community-driven tree donation platform with progress tracking, visual charts, and shareable campaign pages.
projects.problem_en: An environmental donation movement needs a transparent, easily shareable campaign page.
projects.solution_en: A donation tracker with progress charts and shareable milestone cards, built with Next.js.
features_en: Tree donation tracking with a visual chart.
Campaign pages that are easy to share.
Community-friendly UI for an environmental movement.

projects.title: Ibu Hamil App
projects.description: Aplikasi pendamping untuk ibu hamil: tips mingguan, pencatatan jadwal kontrol, dan catatan penting dengan UI sederhana.
projects.problem: Ibu hamil membutuhkan pengingat jadwal kontrol dan panduan mingguan yang mudah diakses.
projects.solution: Aplikasi pendamping dengan tips mingguan dan pencatatan jadwal, dibangun dengan React dan Firebase.
features: Pencatatan jadwal kontrol dan catatan penting.
projects.description_en: A companion app for expecting mothers: weekly tips, appointment scheduling, and notes with a simple UI.
projects.problem_en: Expecting mothers need appointment reminders and a weekly guide that is easy to access.
projects.solution_en: A companion app with weekly tips and appointment notes, built with React and Firebase.

projects.title: Projek Bantenara
projects.shortDescription: Marketing landing page with CTA-focused layout.
projects.description: Landing page modern dengan fokus CTA, hero section responsif, dan layout bersih untuk kebutuhan marketing.
projects.problem: Produk membutuhkan landing page yang menjelaskan value dengan cepat dan mengarahkan ke CTA.
projects.solution: Landing page Next.js dengan hero responsif dan struktur section yang fokus pada konversi.
features: Landing page modern dengan fokus CTA.
Hero section responsif dengan visual yang kuat.
projects.shortDescription_en: Marketing landing page with a CTA-focused layout.
projects.description_en: A modern landing page focused on CTAs, a responsive hero section, and a clean layout for marketing needs.
projects.problem_en: A product needs a landing page that explains its value quickly and drives to a CTA.
projects.solution_en: A Next.js landing page with a responsive hero and a conversion-focused section structure.
features_en: A modern landing page focused on CTAs.
A responsive hero section with strong visuals.
A clean layout for marketing needs.

projects.title: SuruhLeo V1
projects.shortDescription: Logistics dashboard focusing on core delivery metrics.
projects.description: Iterasi pertama dashboard logistik yang fokus pada metrik inti pengiriman dengan tampilan data yang mudah dibaca.
projects.problem: Operasional pengiriman butuh satu tampilan ringkas untuk metrik inti.
projects.solution: Dashboard React dengan kartu metrik dan tabel yang mudah dibaca sebagai fondasi fitur lanjutan.
features: Dashboard logistik dengan metrik inti pengiriman.
Struktur awal untuk pengembangan fitur lanjutan.
projects.shortDescription_en: Logistics dashboard focusing on core delivery metrics.
projects.description_en: The first iteration of a logistics dashboard focused on core delivery metrics with easy-to-read data views.
projects.problem_en: Delivery operations need one concise view for core metrics.
projects.solution_en: A React dashboard with metric cards and readable tables as a foundation for further features.
features_en: A logistics dashboard with core delivery metrics.
An initial structure for further feature development.
